$comment: Golden-versus-reference pairs for `node tools/design-refs compare` (ROADMAP §5 step 11). Each pair names a board of boards.json (its render is <refs>/<board>.png; with `lang`, the language variant <refs>/<board>.<lang>.png of a board with the board-language switch, and the golden in that language) and a golden of the M1 matrix (<goldens>/<screen>_<mac|win>_<light|dark>_<en|tr|ar>.png, a whole 1440 × 900 window at 1x), or says why the board is not compared. `crop` cuts the board render, `goldenCrop` the golden; both must give the same size. `masks` are rectangles in the compared frame (after cropping) that neither score counts. Rectangles are whole pixels: x, y, width, height. README.md explains the fields and the scores.

pairs.cropSource: The strip 'Title bar and mode bar · macOS': the first .fm-root inside section#f6, 1440 × 79 (FmWindow platform=mac mode=edit status=false). Its box, measured in the renderer's page, starts 182.41 px below the board's clip, which Chromium snaps to row 182; in f6.png its 1 px box-shadow ring is row 181, row 261 and column 1440. Checked: the top 79 rows of the a3-1c render (a light macOS Edit window) equal this crop pixel for pixel.
